subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: What public timeout contract should OpenClaw support for generation budgets across global defaults, per-model entries, provider request timeouts, idle/first-event watchdogs, run timeouts, and fallback routing?
rationale: The code path is clear, but naming and precedence for a new config/default surface are product and compatibility decisions that automation should not invent.

options.title: Add a canonical generation budget
options.body: Introduce a typed generationTimeout-style global and per-agent-model contract, resolve it per fallback candidate, and enforce it as a non-resetting generation budget alongside existing idle/request timers.

options.title: Use provider timeout only
options.body: Document models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds as the supported knob and close this direction, accepting that it remains provider-scoped rather than per selected model.

options.title: Wait for adjacent watchdog fixes
options.body: Land or reject the Gemini thinking watchdog work first, then revisit whether a separate public generation budget is still needed.

recommendation.title: Add a canonical generation budget
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed generationTimeout-style global and per-agent-model contract, resolve it per fallback candidate, and enforce it as a non-resetting generation budget alongside existing idle/request timers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already mapped the remaining timeout/config decision in the issue discussion and appears in recent history for the affected timeout surfaces.
